title: The 12 Layers of the AI Boom
subtitle: Explained in 90 seconds

scenes.narration: The trillions of dollars flowing through artificial intelligence pass through twelve distinct layers — most of which you have never heard of.

scenes.label: Already committed
scenes.caption: to AI infrastructure
scenes.narration: Hyperscalers have already committed over five hundred billion dollars to AI infrastructure — and the build-out is only accelerating.

scenes.heading: Where the AI Boom Lives
scenes.narration: Almost the entire stack lives in just four countries: the United States, the Netherlands, Korea, and Taiwan.

scenes.heading: The Stack
scenes.narration: From sand to software, twelve layers stack on top of each other. Each one is its own industry, with its own leaders.

scenes.heading: The Choke Points
scenes.narration: Three single companies effectively control three layers. ASML, NVIDIA, and SK Hynix.

scenes.label: Per ASML EUV machine
scenes.caption: Only one company makes them
scenes.narration: Take ASML. Each of its EUV lithography machines costs four hundred million dollars, and there is no alternative anywhere on Earth.

scenes.heading: The Supply Chain
scenes.narration: Every prompt you type rides on a supply chain that begins in the Netherlands, passes through Taiwan and Korea, and ends in your browser.

scenes.heading: AI Energy Demand
scenes.narration: And the next bottleneck is not chips. It is electricity. By the end of this decade, AI will consume roughly Japan's entire annual power supply.

scenes.heading: The Frontier Labs
scenes.narration: On top sits the visible part — the foundation labs you have heard of. Six contenders, one prize.

scenes.fact: Nine out of ten publicly traded AI infrastructure companies are headquartered in just four countries.
scenes.narration: Nine out of ten of these companies are headquartered in just four countries. The geography of the boom is more concentrated than the gold rush ever was.
